project: Roofing 3D model — enhanced-capture cache + manual capture mode
requirements: (1) Address-keyed cache of Gemini-enhanced captures: when polished screenshots already exist for a property address, reuse them (cross-tenant by design) instead of re-enhancing — saves Gemini tokens. (2) Manual capture mode: tradie takes up to 5 screenshots (front, left, right, back, top) of the photorealistic 3D map; they are polished as usual and fed to model generation. Constraint: Tripo multiview accepts only front/left/back/right — 'top' is enhanced + cached but not sent to Tripo. Auto capture reads the cache; manual capture bypasses the read (deliberate framing wins) but writes its enhanced output to the cache.

stories.title: Enhanced-capture cache lib (address-keyed)
stories.detail: lib/roofing/capture-cache.ts: pure normalizeAddressKey + cachePathFor (tested); getCachedEnhanced/putCachedEnhanced against roof-models bucket under enhanced/{key}/{view}.jpg. Best-effort: cache failures never fail generation.

stories.title: Labeled captures end-to-end (schema + Tripo body, 2-5 views incl. top)
stories.detail: POST body {captures:[{view,image}], mode:'auto'|'manual'} — front required, >=1 of left/back/right, top optional, views unique. buildMultiviewTaskBody emits only provided front/left/back/right slots (top excluded). Tests for partial views + top exclusion.

stories.title: Wire cache into startModel3d + labeled auto-capture client
stories.detail: startModel3d(measureToken, captures, {address, reuseCache}): auto reuses cached enhanced per view, else enhance+store; manual always enhances+stores. Route passes row address + mode. Client auto flow posts labeled views.

stories.title: Manual capture mode UI (front/left/right/back/top)
stories.detail: Roof3DModelSection: 'Manual capture' opens free-orbit Cesium viewer with per-view capture buttons + chips + retake; 'Build 3D model' enabled once front + one side captured; submits mode:'manual'.

stories.title: Quality gates green (completion promise: all tests pass)
stories.detail: npx tsc --noEmit clean; FULL npx vitest run green; /m/[token] renders both Generate and Manual capture entry points.
